\[
\text{DSCR}=\frac{\text{NOI}}{\text{debt service}}\ge 1.25
\]

so the required NOI is

\[
\text{NOI}_t \ge 1.25 \times \text{debt service}_t
\]

For the three debt-service tiers:

- Months 1–3: required NOI \(=1.25(80)=100\)
- Months 4–6: required NOI \(=1.25(110)=137.5\)
- Months 7–12: required NOI \(=1.25(140)=175\)

Let the constant monthly growth rate be \(g\). Then

\[

\]

The tightest constraint is in month 7, the first month with the $140 debt service. Set the month-7 DSCR equal to 1.25:

\[
\frac{130(1+g)^6}{140}=1.25
\]

\[
(1+g)^6=\frac{175}{130}=\frac{35}{26}
\]

\[
1+g=\left(\frac{35}{26}\right)^{1/6}
\]

\[
g=\left(\frac{35}{26}\right)^{1/6}-1 \approx 0.05078964
\]

Rounded to 4 decimal places:

\[
\boxed{0.0508}
\]
